_comment: EXTRACTED from the text of a captured page, not read off an image: Irish
Sailing published this table as HTML on their own event page, which is
gone from the live site and survives only on the Internet Archive. The
figures below are the page's own cells, copied programmatically, so there
is no misreading risk — but the page is not a Sailwave results file, so it
still has to be rendered into that shape to be ingested.
The table has no rank column and its own Nett column is not in order for
the bottom six boats, so no places are published here. See
Five rows contradict themselves in the source and are declared below. They
are carried verbatim: correcting them would be re-scoring, which is exactly
what an as-published archive must not do.
The Boat column is mapped to the sail-number key, keeping its published
label. These are the numbers on the supplied TR3.6s rather than class sail
numbers, but they are the only per-entry identifier the page publishes, and
the identity manifest addresses rows by (series, sail, slot) — without them
all sixteen boats collide on an empty key.
title: Irish Sailing All Ireland Junior Championships 2021
venue: Fastnet Marine and Outdoor Education Centre, Schull, Co Cork
caption: Entries: 16, Boats: TR3.6

sourceDiscrepancies.published: Total 96 less discard 17 is 79, published Nett is 74
sourceDiscrepancies.note: Her discard is marked on R8 (DNF 17) but the Nett implies the medal race (DNS 22) was dropped instead. One of the two markings is wrong; both are published.

sourceDiscrepancies.published: Total 106 less discard 20 is 86, published Nett is 90
sourceDiscrepancies.note: The parenthesised cell is the medal race (20), but the Nett implies R3 (16) was dropped. Same disagreement between the marking and the arithmetic.

sourceDiscrepancies.published: Total 71 less discard 17 is 54, published Nett is 88
sourceDiscrepancies.note: Nett is Total plus 17 rather than minus a discard — the pattern of a boat that missed the medal race and had a 17 added without the Total being restated.

sourceDiscrepancies.note: Nett is Total plus 17, as above.
